steps: Read these five details: address DS Tower 1, Soi Phrom Chit, Sukhumvit Soi 39 · hours Monday to Saturday 10:00 to 18:00, closed Sunday · WhatsApp 086 086 8385 · in business since 1989 · about 8 weeks for a custom bridal outfit.
If anything is wrong, write the right version in the notes box below.
Tick done. Boonchoo corrects the ready text if needed.
Read the English and Thai description below. This same line goes on every listing.
Write any changes in the notes box, or leave it empty if it's right.
Tick done.

items.t: Instagram: switch to a business account
steps: Open Instagram, go to your profile and tap the menu (three lines, top right).
Tap Settings and activity, then Account type and tools, then Switch to professional account. If you see 'Professional dashboard' on your profile already, skip to step 4.
Choose Business, and pick the category Bridal shop (or Clothing store if Bridal shop isn't offered).
Tick done.

items.t: Instagram: new bio and contact buttons
steps: Profile > Edit profile > Bio. Delete the old bio and paste the new one below.
In Edit profile, open Contact options: add phone 086 086 8385 (as WhatsApp if offered), the shop email and the address DS Tower 1, Sukhumvit Soi 39, Bangkok.
Save, then look at the profile from another phone to check it reads well.
Tick done.
Check you are an admin of both Facebook pages, and that both show the same name, category and address (Soi 39). Fix any difference first.
On a computer, go to facebook.com/pages/merge (or business.facebook.com/pages/merge if both pages are in Meta Business Suite).
Choose the main page to keep (the one with about 8,300 followers), then the duplicate, and request the merge. Facebook says it can't be undone and usually takes 24 to 48 hours.
Only likes, check-ins and ratings move across; posts on the duplicate don't. If Facebook refuses, post once on the duplicate asking people to follow the main page, then unpublish it.
Tick done and note what happened.

items.t: Facebook: fill in the page details
steps: On the main page, open Edit details (or Settings > Page setup).
Category: Bridal shop. Address: DS Tower 1, Soi Phrom Chit, Sukhumvit Soi 39. Hours: Monday to Saturday 10:00 to 18:00.
Add phone and a WhatsApp button, and link the Instagram account.
Paste the intro and the Thai About text below.
Tick done.

items.t: Google: fix address, hours and description
steps: Sign in to the Google account that manages the shop, then search Google for Neena Sehgal Bangkok.
In the profile panel choose Edit profile.
Location: change to DS Tower 1, Soi Phrom Chit, Sukhumvit Soi 39 (it shows Soi 33 now). Google may ask you to verify again; follow its steps.
Hours: Monday to Saturday 10:00 to 18:00, Sunday closed. Category: Bridal shop.
Description: paste the long description below. Tick done.

items.t: Google: add photos and get the review link
steps: In the same profile, add 10 recent photos: shop front, studio, six outfits, a fitting.
Find Ask for reviews (or Get more reviews), copy the link and paste it in the notes box.
Tick done. Boonchoo puts the link into the review message.

items.t: Tripadvisor and WedMeGood: replace the description
steps: Tripadvisor: sign in as the owner, open your listing's management page and replace 'Online Indian garment boutique' with the long description below. Set the hours.
WedMeGood: sign in to the vendor account, edit the profile: paste the same description, add your best new photos, check prices and contact.
Tick done.
Bing is Microsoft's map listing, and ChatGPT's web search leans on it.
Sign in at Bing Places with the shop's own Microsoft or Google account (do this after Day 4). Boonchoo can sit with you.
Choose Import from Google Business Profile and confirm the details.
If a verification code arrives by phone or post, enter it. Tick done.
Post a story for each of: Bridal, Groom & sherwani, Sarees, Real brides, Visit us (map, hours, WhatsApp).
On your profile, tap New (+) under Highlights and save each story into its own Highlight with that name.
Optional: make matching Highlight covers in Canva. Tick done.

items.t: Set up the review message for staff
steps: In WhatsApp Business: Settings > Business tools > Quick replies > Add. Shortcut: review. Paste the message below and put the Google review link (Day 4) in place of {Google review link}.
Do the same in LINE if you use it.
Agree with staff: send it to every bride on delivery day. Tick done.

items.t: This week's posts: Mon, Wed, Fri
steps: For each post, open the Write tab: choose the outfit, add colour, fabric and occasion, press Write it.
Check the details, then post the photo with the caption from Meta Business Suite so it goes to Instagram and Facebook together (you can schedule all three at once).
Tag the photographer, planner and venue if you know them. Tick done after the third post.
Masala Thai is Bangkok's Indian community magazine. Its list of Bangkok designers shows up in 14 of the 17 searches and doesn't include Neena Sehgal yet.
The pitch email is ready in Write › Emails. Read it, change anything you like, and press Approve.
Send it from the shop's email with your 5 best photos attached (bride, groom, family look, a sketch, the studio), then press Mark as sent.
Tick done. Boonchoo reminds you to follow up a week later.
Choose 12 photos that show your range: bridal, groom, family, guest, and send them to Boonchoo.
Boonchoo makes a one-page lookbook (in the shop's Canva) and puts the planner message in Write › Emails.
Send it to the seven Bangkok planners from the shop's WhatsApp or email.
Tick done.

items.t: This week's posts: Mon, Wed, Fri
steps: Same as last week: Write tab, then post from Meta Business Suite to Instagram and Facebook, and tag.
Tick done after the third post.

items.t: Ask two brides for a real-wedding feature
steps: Pick two recent weddings with good photos.
Send the message below to each couple from the shop's WhatsApp.
Note in the box: couple, wedding date, venue, planner, photographer. Tick done.
Sign in to the shop's WedMeGood vendor account, and open WeddingSutra's real-wedding submission. Boonchoo can sit with you.
Fill in 'Outfits: Neena Sehgal, Bangkok' and upload the photos the couples agreed to.
Tick done when submitted.
Open Write › Reviews: drafted replies for review sites are waiting there.
For each new Google review or Facebook recommendation, paste it in Write › Reviews, press Write it, check, copy and post it from that site. Reply to the unhappy ones too, calmly.
Tick done.

items.t: This week's posts: Mon, Wed, Fri
steps: Same routine: Write tab, post from Meta Business Suite, tag.
Tick done after the third post.
Count new Google reviews since 16 November and new WedMeGood reviews.
Write both numbers in the notes box. Targets: 5 Google, 3 WedMeGood. Tick done.
Boonchoo asks ChatGPT the 17 searches in fresh sessions and records whether Neena Sehgal is named.
The result appears in Progress.
Look at Progress and the ticks together.
Decide what to keep doing and what's next for the following 30 days. Tick done.

longdesc: Neena Sehgal is an Indian bridal couture boutique in Bangkok, creating wedding outfits since 1989. We design and make bridal lehengas, sherwanis for grooms, sarees, anarkalis and Indo-Western looks, plus outfits for the whole wedding party. Choose a ready-to-wear piece or a fully custom bridal outfit (allow about 8 weeks). We dress brides from Bangkok's Indian community and couples planning destination weddings in Thailand, and we ship abroad. Visit our studio at DS Tower 1, Soi Phrom Chit, Sukhumvit Soi 39, with parking available. Fittings by appointment, Monday to Saturday.
